label: TESTED_SOURCE_ONLY

must_have.check: Externally published admission digest plus exact immutable reviewed seal tuple, rehashed source/seal/prereg/addendum/report/case block. A self-declared authority string or outcome alone cannot create trust.

Report real mode, tests_read true, ADOPT_TAIL, script/prereg/schema bindings, case block bound in prereg, C4T valid, matching driver/blocks and finite carried uncertainty. Do not run compare or read protected outputs merely to build.
PRELAUNCH must bind exact call spec, config, driver, policy and code pins, with boolean true and no failure reasons; do not trust a stale record for another spec.

Native v006r9 prelaunch_check intentionally skips certificate_check when certificate_registry is null. Therefore separately require certificate_policy_gate and point certificate_check or equivalently reviewed bound record; PRELAUNCH alone is insufficient.

Point identity and independently derived custody, approved producer byte hashes, actual EPS/LO slots, reviewed prelaunch LO envelope for all consumed states, GQ and contiguous shell domain. This is metadata assurance, not derivation of producer science.

Only exact headline D=4.04 exempt. Sensitivity at each D requires exact-D pair evidence and distinct reviewed registration; current native policy fails closed because comparator successor unapproved. DIII should not require its own future result; any explicit not-applicable branch must be scoped tail-OFF paired spec.
Current r5 SHA exact; a DIII reference v009-GEO exception must bind role/spec and be explicitly admitted, not broaden all calls. No r6/cache adoption implied.

First and later calls enforce memory/caps; no borrowed KHI exemption. Exact complete iteration event, predecessor termination without event halts, one start per poll, route-A count and all outputs unique, systemic setup/RSS/output/disk failures stop pending; no retries.

Root monitors normal QoS per adopted core-priority extension; lane tests nice10/background preferred. Launcher PID has caffeinate -i -w assertion before scientific subprocess; assertion failure/refusal halts. Launchers must not inherit accidental lane low QoS as unstated production setting.

Canonical resolved path aliases and ancestor collisions rejected; exclusive create outputs and logs; no protected C5H/UVT paths or marked copies. Check output before open, inputs before protected read; preserve failures.

Only exclusive new output names; exact source and spec pins. Partially written first output on later collision preserved and reported; binder never spawns processes. Final root adoption/policy refs remain pending until real bytes exist.

Repeat material admission/code/spec checks immediately before each Popen after waits; refuse new or changed evidence. A caller-supplied executable or plan monkeypatch cannot bypass production entry gating.

findings.detail: Native v006r9 prelaunch_check plans with certificate_registry=None; separate certificate gate mandatory.
Native adoption tuple allowlist is empty; sensitivity comparator reviewed flag false. Do not fabricate readiness.
Claude4 launch_order v001 includes unguarded fallback and preseal DIII; root0620 forbids fallback and requires all admission controls before process.

limitations: No candidate code existed at audit start. No production imports, monitor/forward runs, saved-output comparison, target reads or scientific computations were executed.
No final Claude4 V002 order existed at audit start; proposals are not new root rulings.
Root publication authentication is an operational trust boundary; byte digests do not cryptographically prove authorship.
